title: Rethinking GFlowNet Training: Negative Reinforce Dynamics
abstract: arXiv:2610.38994v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative Flow Networks (GFlowNets) are models that learn to sample discrete objects proportional to a target reward. They are trained by minimizing balance errors over sampled trajectories, which inherently ties correctness to exploration: if a region is not visited, balance cannot be enforced there. Adaptive exploration is therefore crucial, yet standard training relies on a semi-gradient update that treats the sampling distribution as fixed at each optimization step. On the other hand, the full gradient reveals a second mechanism that reduces the observed errors in an anti-exploratory manner. In this paper, we establish a connection between the full gradient and min-min dynamics between the GFlowNet and a decoupled sampler, showing that the sampler reduces observed violations by avoiding high-error regions. This insight motivates a bridge between two-player games and single-policy dynamics, which underpins the design of our propose

translated_title: 重新思考GFlowNet训练：负强化动力学
translated_abstract: 生成流网络（GFlowNets）是一类学习按目标奖励成比例采样离散对象的模型。它们通过在采样轨迹上最小化平衡误差进行训练，这本质上将正确性与探索绑定在一起：如果某个区域未被访问，就无法在该区域强制执行平衡。因此，自适应探索至关重要，然而标准训练依赖于半梯度更新，即在每次优化步骤中将采样分布视为固定的。另一方面，完整梯度揭示了一种以反探索方式减少观测误差的第二种机制。在本文中，我们建立了完整梯度与GFlowNet和解耦采样器之间的min-min动力学之间的联系，表明采样器通过避开高误差区域来减少观测到的误差违规。这一洞察启发我们在双人博弈与单策略动力学之间架起桥梁，为我们的方法设计奠定了基础。
tldr: 本文揭示了GFlowNet完整梯度训练中存在一种反探索机制，通过将其与解耦采样器之间的min-min动力学建立联系，在双人博弈与单策略动力学之间架起桥梁，从而改进GFlowNet的自适应探索训练。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals an anti-exploratory mechanism in full-gradient GFlowNet training by connecting it to min-min dynamics between the GFlowNet and a decoupled sampler, bridging two-player games and single-policy dynamics to enable adaptive exploration in GFlowNet training.
